notes: Custom Exam Schedule now works exactly like Custom Timetable: pick by SCHOOL (FSC / FSM / FSE), then batch, department and course by NAME (no more code-only dropdowns). One saved schedule instead of bundles — Save to keep it, then optionally set it as your exam preference (bookmark). The exam preference is new and separate from your timetable preference, ready to power the upcoming exam widgets. The Exams tab also gets a bookmark to tag your default selection.
